title: How to choose a home nurse for your family in Qatar: 5 questions worth asking
description: Before a nurse enters your home, these questions help you choose with confidence and peace of mind.
image_alt: Home nurse with the care team
body:
Choosing a nurse who will come into your home and care for a loved one is a decision that deserves care. To help you feel at ease from the very first day, here are the key questions worth asking any home nursing provider.

## 1. Is the nurse right for the patient's condition?
You are entitled to know that the nurse entering your home has experience in the kind of care your loved one needs. Ask how a nurse is chosen for each case.

## 2. What exactly will the nurse do?
Ask for a clear outline of tasks: medication follow-up per the doctor's prescription, vital signs, help with mobility and personal care, and so on. Clarity from the start reassures both you and the patient.

## 3. How will I receive updates on the patient?
If you are at work or away, you will want to know what happened at each visit. Ask whether you receive a report after every visit, and how.

## 4. Who do I contact if I need something?
A follow-up team that responds in your language and handles any concern promptly makes a real difference.

## 5. Does the nurse follow the treating doctor's instructions?
A home nurse supports the doctor's plan; she does not change it. Make sure she follows the doctor's instructions and informs you of any change she notices.

> Tip: note your questions before you call, and share any reports or doctor's instructions so the provider can choose the right nurse for you.

At **Dar Alamana** we choose the nurse according to the patient's needs, you receive a patient-status report on WhatsApp after every visit, and our Arabic-speaking team stays in close contact with you throughout.
